project_type: Next.js 14 React PWA with Supabase backend and TypeScript
build_system: Next.js (npm run build, npm run dev)
test_framework: None configured; manual testing via dev server
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run build` to verify no TypeScript/build errors. 2. Start dev server with `npm run dev` and manually test each feature via browser. 3. Verify localStorage persistence across page reloads. 4. Test keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, Ctrl+F on Windows; Cmd variants on Mac).
environment_constraints: App uses Supabase (configured via env vars). Undo/redo snapshots stored in localStorage. Export uses browser Download API (requires user interaction). Search is client-side only. No server-side changes needed.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns: use usePlanner() context hook for state, show toasts for user feedback via showToast(), persist state to localStorage, sync to Supabase if user is logged in. Use lucide-react icons. Follow Tailwind CSS utility class style (bg-court, text-ink, etc.) from existing codebase.
key_patterns: 1. Store: All state centralized in PlannerContext (src/lib/storage/store.tsx). Actions are named functions that update state and call showToast() and syncToSupabase(). 2. Modals: SettingsModal, AuthModal, ProfileModal follow same structure (isOpen prop, onClose callback, bg-card / border-2 border-ink / rounded-card styling). 3. Components: Use Tailwind utility classes (no custom CSS). Icons from lucide-react. State lifted to context or component useState. 4. UI: Desktop sidebar (left rail ~260px), center content, optional right panel on XL+. Mobile: bottom tab bar with raised center '+' button. 5. Persistence: All state saved to localStorage on change, synced to Supabase if user logged in.
relevant_files: src/lib/storage/store.tsx (core store with all state and actions)
directory_structure: src/ — app/ (Next.js routes and API), components/ (ui/, modals, layout, tabs), lib/ (storage/store, utils/, constants/, supabase/), types/ (database.ts). All state in store.tsx. All UI components in components/. All utilities in lib/utils/.
